Excellent! All tests pass. I've added the `vatSummary` function to `src/reports.js` with comprehensive tests.

## Summary

Added `vatSummary(invoices)` to `src/reports.js` that:
- Filters invoices with status `'issued'`, `'partially_paid'`, or `'paid'`
- Groups by VAT rate and calculates:
  - `base`: sum of line amounts after discounts (rounded to cents)
  - `vat`: sum of VAT calculated per line (rounded at line level, then summed)
- Returns array of `{ rate, base, vat }` objects
- Sorts by rate descending (high to low: 21%, 9%, 0%)

Added 22 tests in `test/reports.test.js` covering:
- Null/empty input handling
- Status filtering (includes issued/partially_paid/paid, excludes draft)
- Single and multiple VAT rates
- Discount calculations (explicit line discounts and tier discounts)
- Multiple invoices aggregation
- Payment status independence
- Edge cases and large datasets

All 292 project tests pass.
